content: WikiHop and MedHop: These are two recent datasets introduced in BIBREF13 . Unlike SQuAD and NewsQA, important facts are spread out across multiple documents and, in order to answer a question, it is necessary to jump over a set of passages to collect the required information. The relevant passages are not explicitly mentioned in the data so this dataset measures the ability that a model has to navigate across multiple documents. The questions come with a set of candidates which are all present in the text.
